resources.string:
FlowForge uses this service only to put the text you dictate into the text field you are typing in.

What it does: when you finish a dictation with the FlowForge bubble, it finds the focused text field and inserts your words at the cursor (or replaces your selection).

What it does not do: it never reads, stores or sends the content of other apps, never acts on password fields, and does nothing while you are not dictating.

You can use the FlowForge Voice Keyboard instead if you prefer not to enable this service.
Shown while the floating dictation bubble is available. Required by Android for microphone access.
Tells you when the bubble could not start or stopped unexpectedly.
